scope: Unmodified raw ExpertKnowledge.search only; excludes chat query expansion, claim-source validation and model generation.

construction.author: A separate evaluation agent in the same project team
construction.created_after: The original 40-query set was exposed and reclassified as discovery/dev.
construction.freeze_policy: Share only the case count and SHA256 before the ranker author freezes the algorithm. Run once after that freeze; retain every miss and false positive. Do not edit queries, gold labels, topics or the ranker in response to this set.
construction.coverage: 24 new questions: 18 relevant, including 4 multi-topic questions; 6 irrelevant or outside the corpus; 12 Chinese and 12 English. New phrasing rather than copied chunk titles.
construction.limitation: Same-team manual gold labels and a small convenience sample. This is neither an external benchmark nor a measure of answer accuracy, citation entailment, market validity or predictive skill.

metric_definitions.recall_at_k: Mean over relevant queries of |top-k IDs intersect gold IDs| / |gold IDs|.
metric_definitions.mrr_at_k: Mean reciprocal rank of the first gold ID among the first k results; zero when absent. Relevant queries only.
metric_definitions.all_gold_hit_rate_at_k: Fraction of relevant queries for which every labelled ID is in top-k; separates complete multi-topic retrieval from merely finding one source.
metric_definitions.facet_recall_at_k: Mean fraction of required claim facets covered by the retrieved documents' supports.
metric_definitions.no_hit_abstention_rate: Fraction of no-hit queries returning an empty list; its complement is the false-positive rate.
metric_definitions.scores_are_not: Answer accuracy, confidence, citation entailment, market validation or prediction success.

limitations: Gold relevance is manually authored by a project maintainer, not independently adjudicated.
Split role and prior exposure are recorded in construction; this is not a blind external benchmark.
No answer accuracy, source entailment, numeric correctness or prediction performance is measured.
Facet coverage is a reviewed metadata mapping, not an automatic proof that an answer is entailed.
Known misses and incidental lexical matches are retained; no ranker changes were made from this evaluation.
